_sources: Civil: HMK m. 104 (a period ending in the recess is extended one week from the day it ends); https://barandogan.av.tr/blog/mevzuat/hmk-madde-104.html
Administrative: İYUK m. 8/3 (seven days from the end of the recess); https://imer.av.tr/adli-tatil
Criminal: CMK m. 331/4 (three days from the end of the recess; not for detention matters); https://hukukcularevi.com/adli-tatil-ceza-davalari-sureler-cmk-331/
Enforcement: periods under İİK are not extended by the recess; https://www.harbiyehukuk.com/adli-tatilde-gorulen-davalar/

Electronic service: Tebligat Kanunu m. 7/a(4), deemed served at the end of the fifth day after reaching the address; https://hukukcularevi.com/e-tebligat-uets-geldi-sure-ne-zaman-baslar-hak-kaybi-nasil-onlenir/
